eps.ov: The match with Inarizaki High at the Spring Tournament finally begins. Karasuno is overpowered by the supreme Miya Twins and the Inarizaki cheer section taking over the venue. It was then that a certain someone arrived in the stands...
eps.oa: تبدأ أخيراً مباراة ثانوية «إيناريزاكي» في بطولة الربيع. فتتغلب على «كاراسونو» براعة التوأمين «ميا» الفائقة، ومشجعو إيناريزاكي الذين يسيطرون على الملعب. حينها وصل أحدهم إلى المدرجات...

eps.ov: Karasuno is able to regain their rhythm with Saeko's help, but the Miya Twins weirdo quick gives Inarizaki the lead. How will Karasuno deal with this unexpected turn of events?
eps.oa: تستعيد «كاراسونو» إيقاعها بعون «سايكو»، لكن الهجمة السريعة الغريبة للتوأمين «ميا» تمنح «إيناريزاكي» التقدم. فكيف تتعامل كاراسونو مع هذا التحول غير المتوقع؟

eps.ov: Because of Yamaguchi's service ace at the end of the first set, Karasuno is able to get set point first. However, Inarizaki then starts targeting Tanaka, who seems a bit off his game. How will Tanaka deal with this pressure?
eps.oa: بفضل إرسال «ياماغوتشي» الساحق في نهاية الشوط الأول تبلغ «كاراسونو» نقطة الشوط أولاً. لكن «إيناريزاكي» تبدأ تستهدف «تاناكا»، الذي يبدو غير موفق في لعبه. فكيف يتعامل تاناكا مع هذا الضغط؟

eps.ov: In their match against Inarizaki, Karasuno manages to take the first set. Meanwhile on another court, Nekoma High School was going up against Ishikawa’s team, Sarukawa Tech. They’re both known for their defense. Who will come out the victor?
eps.oa: تنجح «كاراسونو» في الفوز بالشوط الأول أمام «إيناريزاكي». وفي الأثناء، في ملعب آخر، تواجه ثانوية «نيكوما» فريق «إيشيكاوا»، ثانوية «ساروكاوا» التقنية، والفريقان معروفان بدفاعهما. فمن يخرج منتصراً؟

eps.ov: ekoma and Sarukawa Tech both show no signs of slowing down. They realize that Sarukawa is trying to wear down Kenma’s stamina, so Kenma comes up with a plan...
eps.oa: لا تبدي «نيكوما» ولا ثانوية «ساروكاوا» التقنية أي علامة على التباطؤ. ويدركون أن ساروكاوا تحاول استنزاف لياقة «كينما»، فيدبّر كينما خطة...

eps.ov: Nekoma High School moves to the 3rd round after defeating Sarukawa High School. Meanwhile, Karasuno and Inarizaki head into their second set and Miya Atsumu starts to target Nishinoya with his serves.
eps.oa: تتأهل ثانوية «نيكوما» إلى الدور الثالث بعد هزيمة ثانوية «ساروكاوا». وفي الأثناء تدخل «كاراسونو» و«إيناريزاكي» الشوط الثاني، ويبدأ «أتسومو ميا» يستهدف «نيشينويا» بإرساله.

eps.ov: Karasuno starts to break down Inarizaki's dominance with Kageyama's serves. And to counter that, Inarizaki sends in their captain, Kita Shinsuke to get their rhythm back.

Because Karasuno's plays become messy and the match's rhythm gets thrown off, they change setters. Sugawara goes onto the court in place of Kageyama and because he's always seen things from outside the court, he says he knows what's going on, and Karasuno starts their counterattack. Meanwhile, after seeing the match from the outside, there's a change in Kageyama as well.
Inarizaki starts to turn things around with Miya Atsumu's serves. Suddenly, there is a play that changes the flow of the game.

eps.t: The Birth of the Serene King
eps.ov: The third set is reaching its end. Karasuno is able to take back the flow of the game with Hinata's receive and even though they show great offense and defense, Inarizaki gets a match point. With the game so down to the wire, the setter Kageyama decides to do a certain play...
The game is now in a deuce with both teams are pushed to their limits to try to get that one final point. This match against Inarizaki brings out everything that both teams have to the very end!
The Miyagi Prefecture Inter-High is now over. Hinata, Kageyama, and the other members of Karasuno have a lot on their minds...
